notes: v642 - three fixes to pending orders, found from a real order that sat unfilled for five days. 1) MISSED DAYS ARE NOW CAUGHT UP. The fill check only ever ran when you opened the Portfolio window, and it only looked at the ONE session currently loaded - so if your limit was touched on a day you did not happen to open the app, that day's prices were replaced the next morning and the fill was lost silently. It now reads the daily history already saved on your device and judges every day the order has not been tested against yet, using the same rules: a gap below your limit fills at the open, an intraday low through your limit fills at your limit. Existing pending orders will catch up the next time data loads. 2) BOTH ACCOUNTS ARE NOW CHECKED, when fresh data lands rather than only when a window is open - previously an order on My trading went unchecked while you sat on the Auto-pilot tab. 3) The pencil-edit on a pending limit price now refuses an edit that would put your buy limit at or above its take-profit target (or at or below its stop). An order in that state fills and is sold straight back at a loss, badged as a target - the manual buy form has always blocked this, the edit button did not. If you have a pending order showing a target BELOW its buy price, cancel it and place it again. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
